questions.prompt: A sector of a circle has radius 6 cm and angle 5π/6 radians. Find (a) its arc length, (b) its area and (c) its perimeter, leaving answers in terms of π. [3 marks]
questions.modelAnswer: Arc length is s=rθ=6×(5π/6)=5π cm. Sector area is A=½r²θ=½×36×(5π/6)=15π cm². The perimeter includes two radii: P=12+5π cm.
markPoints: The perimeter includes two radii: P=12+5π cm.
